# MDL501 · `unknown-table-key`

<!-- Generated by tools/gendocs from internal/rules: do not edit. -->

A key of a table section that mydumper does not know.

| | |
|---|---|
| Family | tables |
| Default severity | error |
| Fix | unsafe |
| Design references | F8 |

## Why

In a table section mydumper reads a fixed set of keys (`where`, `limit`, `rows`, `columns_on_select`, …, which depend on the version) and masked columns written `` `column` ``. Any other key is ignored without a word: a misspelled `wehre` dumps the whole table.

## Example

With mydumper v0.19.3-3:

❌ Before:

```ini
[`app`.`users`]
wehre=id > 10
rows=1000
num_thread=4
`email`=random_string
```

```text
2:1-2:6 error MDL501[unknown-table-key] `wehre` is not a table key mydumper knows in v0.19.3-3: did you mean `where`?
  = mydumper ignores it: [`app`.`users`] behaves as if the line were absent.
  fix (unsafe): Rename the key to `where`
4:1-4:11 error MDL501[unknown-table-key] `num_thread` is not a table key mydumper knows in v0.19.3-3: did you mean `num_threads`?
  = mydumper ignores it: [`app`.`users`] behaves as if the line were absent.
  fix (unsafe): Rename the key to `num_threads`
```

✅ After `mydumper-lint check --fix --unsafe-fixes`:

```ini
[`app`.`users`]
where=id > 10
rows=1000
num_threads=4
`email`=random_string
```

## Configuration

Enabled by default. To change its severity or turn it off:

```yaml
rules:
  severity:
    MDL501: warning   # or error, info, off
```

To accept one occurrence, put `# mydumper-lint: disable-next-line=MDL501` on the line above it.
